text:
Ryan Cho: Hey folks :wave: I'm Ryan, joining Ops on the Platform team (PST). Laptop arrives tomorrow. Quick checks: who do I ping for VPN and registry access? Also curious if someone is my buddy. Tiny fun fact: I'm a collector of vintage mechanical keyboards.

IT Bot: Hi Ryan! Welcome to Redwood. Please confirm your work email (ryan.cho@example.com) to proceed with MDM invite. For VPN/registry access open an infra ticket and tag @Marta Ruiz.

Marta Ruiz: Welcome Ryan :tada: I'm the infra onboarding lead — tag me for access and I'll queue the registry/VPN approvals after MDM enrolls. Buddy assigned: @Eliot Ford. I'll also create the HW request for a 27" monitor unless you prefer 24".

Eliot Ford: Hey Ryan :wave: I'm Eliot, your buddy for the first month. Happy to pair on onboarding and PRs. We'll do a 30m sync on day 2. For SSH, we use ed25519 keys managed via MDM. After enrollment run:

```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ryan@redwood"
```

Then upload the pubkey to https://id.redwood/internal-keys and request cluster access.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Ryan Cho! MDM invite sent to ryan.cho@example.com. Please enroll within 24 hours to avoid delays. If you don't receive it, reply here and we'll resend.

Ryan Cho: Got the MDM invite! Enrolling now. Re: monitor size, 27" is perfect. And if anyone's into keyboard rabbit holes, ping me :keyboard:

Marta Ruiz: MDM confirmed. I've started the registry/VPN approval flow. Expect tokens once your keys are uploaded. Welcome aboard!

Eliot Ford: :thumbsup: Also, quick pro tip — set up your ssh config with ControlMaster for faster dev cluster sessions. I'll drop a short snippet in DMs. See you at the intro circle tomorrow 11am PST.

Ryan Cho: Thanks everyone  excited to join!
